fuente.titulo: Pope at Angelus: Christian joy is ‘gift of God for world’s salvation’ - Vatican News

caption:
“It is as genuine as the work, the smiles, the tears, the handshakes, and the acts of kindness that fill our days. It is a gift of God for the salvation of the world.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Angelus (2026)

Via Vatican News, 11 October 2026
